summary_en: Asahi Kasei's subsidiary Asahi Kasei Homes will launch a tender offer to acquire all shares of Morigumi Corporation (1853) at 564 yen per share, with a minimum purchase target of 11,922,100 shares, during a 35-business-day period from November 13, 2026 to January 7, 2027. The target company's board has endorsed the offer and recommended shareholder participation.
title_en: Notice regarding commencement of tender offer by subsidiary (Asahi Kasei Homes Corporation) for ordinary shares of Morigumi Corporation (Securities Code: 1853)
translation_en_brief:
Asahi Kasei Homes Corporation, a subsidiary of Asahi Kasei Corporation (3407), announced the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all shares of Morigumi Corporation (Securities Code: 1853), listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. The offer will run for 35 business days from November 13, 2026 to January 7, 2027, with a purchase price of 564 yen per share. The minimum number of shares targeted for acquisition is 11,922,100 shares. The stated purpose is to make Morigumi a wholly-owned subsidiary.

The target company's board of directors has expressed support for the tender offer and has recommended that shareholders participate in the offer. The disclosure notes that Asahi Kasei Homes' parent company is Asahi Kasei Corporation, making this a transaction within the Asahi Kasei group to achieve full ownership of Morigumi Corporation.
